contributions.statement: Mid-training on contexts built by recursively resolving a file's calls (AST + language server + installed packages) adds ~3 points on long-context code QA for an 8B model.
contributions.evidence: §5 Table 3 ablation on 8B only, single run per variant; control corpus differs in several categories.

contributions.statement: Build cross-repo agent context by deterministic dependency traversal (language server plus build metadata) rather than embedding search.
contributions.evidence: Reviewer extrapolation only; the paper tests the traversal as training data, never as inference-time retrieval, and only for Python.

reason: A training-data recipe for model builders; the team will not mid-train, and the only harness idea is not tested by the paper.
